headline: Saksoft declares financial results for the quarter ended September 2026
hook: September quarter financial results submitted to exchange
summary: Saksoft Limited has formally submitted its financial results for the period ending September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. These filings provide the latest operational and financial update for the company. Indian retail investors tracking the IT and software services sector can review these numbers to assess the company's recent performance.
why_it_matters: Review Saksoft's quarterly numbers for earnings performance updates.

headline: Saksoft Limited announces amalgamation and merger scheme
summary: Saksoft Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding a corporate amalgamation and merger. The filing provides preliminary notice of the structural reorganization. Further details regarding the entities involved and share swap ratios are awaited in subsequent disclosures. Retail investors holding Saksoft shares should monitor upcoming exchange filings for material financial impacts.
whats_next: Detailed merger scheme and exchange filings
why_it_matters: Structural changes may alter share value and capital structure
